label: Rock dramatique théâtral
blurb: Théâtralité habitée, ruptures, excès maîtrisé — sans metal.
core: theatrical art rock, tension and release

grafts.label: Interaction jazz-rock
grafts.phrase: jazz-rock drum-and-bass interplay, displaced accents, conversational fills

grafts.label: Quatuor à cordes
grafts.phrase: a close-miked string quartet with rosin and bow noise

grafts.label: Flûtes mellotron
grafts.phrase: wobbly mellotron flutes haunting the quiet parts

grafts.label: Ampli poussé
grafts.phrase: an overdriven British valve-amp guitar adds bite and physical attack

far.label: Arpèges 8-bit
far.phrase: low-bit tracker-style arpeggios and crunchy 8-bit sample hits

far.label: Mode oriental
far.phrase: a lead line in a Middle-Eastern maqam mode, quarter-tone bends

far.label: Contrepoint clavecin
far.phrase: dry baroque harpsichord counterpoint against the band

extra: staged like a play in three acts

presets.label: Tension nerveuse
presets.note: Groove nerveux, basse claquante, claviers dramatiques.
detail: a nervous jittery groove, slapping bass driving, dramatic piano stabs over crunchy guitar

presets.label: Grandiose sombre
presets.note: Piano dramatique, synthés, montée grandiose et sombre.
detail: dramatic classical-tinged piano figures, analog arpeggios, a dark grand ascent

presets.label: Ballade incendiée
presets.note: Ballade lente qui brûle, guitares hurlantes, chaos final.
detail: a slow burning ballad shape, a crying guitar lead, collapsing into a feedback storm

presets.label: Western gothique
presets.note: Duel au soleil noir : guitare baryton trémolo, toms martelés, orgue.
detail: a gothic western standoff, tremolo baritone guitar, pounding toms, organ drones closing in
